_doc: Staged, reversible move of Ultrastable assets from the QNFO (quniverse) account to the dedicated Ultrastable account. The source is never deleted by this plan; deletion is a later, separate item after a soak period. Driven by scripts/cf_account.py.

not_moved.demo-child-ultrastable: demo tenant; redeployed by its own bootstrap

stages.do: cf_account.py inventory <source> and <target>; write the result to deploy/transfer/inventory-*.json
cf_account.py transfer copy --apply: D1 export/import, KV, worker code with bindings remapped; crons off on target
stages.exit: state.stage = copied; secret names listed for re-binding

stages.do: cf_account.py transfer verify: workers present, D1 row counts equal per table; then GET /health on the target worker
cf_account.py transfer cutover --apply: enable crons on target first, then remove from source (never zero hosts)
stages.exit: a tick row written on the target within 15 minutes

stages.do: cf_account.py transfer rollback --apply: crons back to source, removed from target; nothing deleted
stages.exit: a tick row written on the source within 15 minutes

stages.do: after 7 days of clean ticks on the target, file an item to retire source copies
stages.exit: item filed with owner and probe

manual_after_cutover: custom domains (ultrastable.io/.app/.net) are zone-bound: move the zone or re-attach the routes in the zone's account
re-bind worker secrets by name from the repo secret store (values are never read from Cloudflare)

progress.stage: 4-cutover done for crons (tick */10, dashboard */10 and 13:00, site :17 run on the target; the source copies have none); public domains still served by the source (zones); ops D1 copy pending

evidence.traffic: target: ultrastable-site 1,821 requests and ultrastable-tick 110 on 2026-11-16; source: ultrastable-site serves ultrastable.io/.app/.net custom domains
evidence.free_plan: the target account is on the Workers free plan; D1 refused queries at 08:2xZ with code 7500 (daily row-read limit, 5 million). Reads that day: ultrastable-ops 4.33M (analytics scans of hits), ultrastable-org 1.23M. READ-BUDGET-1 (analytics 0.2.0, migration 0016_read_indexes.sql) bounds them
evidence.ops_d1: not copied: the target refused reads for the rest of the day (free plan limit); retried after 00:00 UTC. Auth tables (otp, sessions, passkeys, passkey_challenges, oauth_codes, oauth_tokens) are copied as schema only

previous.stage: 2-copy done, 3-verify done; 4-cutover not started (crons still on the source)

evidence.code: agents, dashboard, tick, site copied byte-for-byte from the source's live versions (deployed 2026-11-15T20:24Z) with bindings remapped by id_map; workers.dev on (*.ultrastable.workers.dev); no crons on the target
evidence.data: org D1 copied table by table at 2026-11-15T20:33Z (items 321/321, dispatches 567/567, outcomes 381/381, tick_runs 785/785, roles 11/11, handoffs 46/46); credentials, credential_events, agent_keys and webhook_subscriptions deliberately not copied; ops D1 not yet copied; ledger table _copy_progress on the target
evidence.secrets_on_target: tick: CREDENTIAL_KEY (new, random), INTERNAL_DEPLOY_KEY, GITHUB_REPOS; site: INTERNAL_DEPLOY_KEY, CF_ACCOUNT_ID. Generated inside Cloudflare, never printed
evidence.probe: GET https://ultrastable-tick.ultrastable.workers.dev/health returns ok true; GET https://ultrastable-site.ultrastable.workers.dev/api/v1/status returns heartbeat

blockers.what: site CF_DEPLOY_TOKEN and tick CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN for the target are not bound yet

the GitHub App private key is sealed under the source tick CREDENTIAL_KEY, which Cloudflare never returns. An in-Cloudflare re-seal (old key to new key, value never leaving Cloudflare) was refused by the session permission check on 2026-11-15 and fully reverted. Routes left: the re-seal with explicit approval, or the target tick runs the GitHub App connect flow (/connect/github on ultrastable-tick.ultrastable.workers.dev). Until then a cutover would stop merges and deploys, so crons stay on the source
blockers.who: owner: GitHub App reconnect on the target, or approve the re-seal

blockers.what: ultrastable.io/.app/.net/.org are Cloudflare Registrar domains on the old account (registered 2026-11-10, auto-renew off, expiry 2027-11-10). Cloudflare moves a Registrar domain between accounts only by a request from the source account's Manage Domain page, confirmed by the target account, once the registration is 10 days old (from 2026-11-20). All zone settings are lost in the move, so the DNS records and Workers custom domains are recreated on the target first
blockers.who: owner: the two Cloudflare confirmations (needs-you item domains-move)

blockers.what: R2 not enabled on the target (error 10042); enabling accepts terms in the dashboard
scripts/cf_account.py copy uploads multi-module workers as one worker.js, ignores service-binding order, never refreshes a non-empty target D1

cutover_order: GitHub credential on the target tick (reconnect or approved re-seal)
site CF_DEPLOY_TOKEN and tick CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN for the target
delta re-copy of org D1 and copy of ops D1 in the same minute crons move
doctrine/topology.json account_id and store ids switched in one PR
target crons on, source crons off
front door: zones stay in the source; ultrastable.io forwards to the target site until the zones move
